cells.gaps: No source found says the bureau or a certifier accredited in Kenya offers certification against a national standard on information technology or data.
cells.note: The Kenya Bureau of Standards, set up under the Standards Act in 1974 (KEN-004), has issued KS 3007, a Code of Practice for AI Applications, reported in November 2026 (KEN-005): a national standard on information technology. No certification against such a standard is held, so stage 4 is not met.
